title: Juice N Power Grape Ice Power Salt 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Grape Ice Power Salt from Juice N Power is a simple, classic blend that delivers an irresistible rush of flavour and refreshment with every vape. Juicy-sweet and tangy dark grapes are layered with waves of icy-cool menthol for a sweet and refreshing all-day vape. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
